verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch has AI-powered features (renaming requests, generating structured payloads, and writing pre-request/test scripts) built into the product, which is a form of task delegation to an AI assistant, but this is narrow in scope compared to a general-purpose built-in AI assistant that can be delegated broader tasks. Missing for 10: evidence of a conversational/agentic assistant capable of open-ended task delegation, broader automation beyond scripting/payload generation, and independent/hands-on corroboration of these AI features working well.
